name: Lesson 2 School then
unit_name: Unit 3 School: now, then and future
definition: 学习用 there was/were 介绍过去学校的状况，并进行今昔对比。
key_points: 核心词汇：toilet 厕所, ago 以前, fifty 五十, people 人们, field 田地, chore 杂活, subject 科目, maths 数学, PE 体育, art 美术, science 科学, music 音乐, after-school club 课外社团, walk 走路, bike 自行车
核心句型：There was a small playground.
There was no library in our school.
We did not have any after-school clubs.
语法点：there be 句型的过去式（There was/were ...）；一般过去式（had, did, walked, worked）；不规则动词 was/were；现在 vs 过去的对比
common_mistakes: There was 后接复数名词、There were 后接单数名词的错误
一般过去式否定形式 did not 后忘记用动词原形
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
